title: Proposed BI border fee to affect OFW rehires, say immigration experts

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Nearly two million overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) returning to the country would be affected by the proposed border fee by the Bureau of Immigration (BI), some immigration experts said. Loreto Soriano, an expert from the Migration and Policy Development Center, raised concern that the proposed border fee amounting to P240, or $4 dollars, to Filipino travelers may also affect OFWs, particularly rehires. OFW rehires, also known as “Balik-Manggagawa,” are workers who return to the country for a vacation or after a contract to renew their employment with the same employer or principal.
